svg.title: Vis gallery: Line 10⁸
svg.desc: The public showcase gallery at /gallery. The left nav lists vis types and axis patterns with their target scale. The main area runs a live line chart of 1 000 series × 100 000 points with an fps, frame-time and point-count readout, a frame-time strip and a WebGPU/WebGL2 tier switch and theme switch. The right panel holds the editable declarative spec in mono and a Use in a board button.

g.text: 1 000 series × 100 000 pts · GPU per-pixel min/max decimation, lossless
Seeded synthetic telemetry · seed 42 · 7 days at 6 s step
colour = stable hash of pod identity · 1 px stroke · opacity 0.35
zoom 1.0× · LOD min/max per px · raw source at ≥ 96×
GPU 312 MB · compute decimation 0.9 ms · draw 2.4 ms
last 240 frames · p50 4.1 ms · p99 6.8 ms · max 7.9 ms
golden image ✓ · bench p99 6.8 ms on iGPU ref
Copies the spec to a board
